Notifications for this app are switched off on your phone, so you will not get alerts. Allow them in your phone\'s settings.
Notify me when the block changes
Notifications are created on your phone. The app sends no data for them. To save battery, a notification may arrive a few minutes late.
Current block icon in the status bar
Together with the icon, a notification shows the current block and the time of the next change. Android always draws status bar icons in one colour; the block colour is visible in the notification.
Optional: connect your metering point with an API token from the Moj Elektro portal and see your consumption by time block in the Consumption tab.

The token and EIMM are encrypted with a key in your phone\'s secure storage (Android Keystore). They are sent only to the official Moj Elektro server (api.informatika.si). Disconnecting deletes the token, the EIMM and all stored readings.
The token, the EIMM and all stored readings will be deleted from this phone. This does not revoke the token on mojelektro.si. This cannot be undone.
How to move consumption to cheaper blocks

Unofficial app; the valid data is published by the official sources
Tarifni semafor – moja poraba works without an account. What you enter stays on this phone.
Your data stays on the phone

Time blocks, the network price list and news come from official public sources (uro.si, SODO, Energy Agency), the public price file from tarifnisemafor.si. The app sends no data about you. The hosting provider of tarifnisemafor.si automatically records the IP address and time of each download; this record is deleted within about one day, and the developer does not use it or link it to anything.
The token, the EIMM and your readings are encrypted (Android Keystore, AES-256-GCM), excluded from backups and sent only to the official Moj Elektro server. They are never sent to analytics.
The app uses no cookies, no ads and no tracking.

Analytics is NOT built into the app today, so this choice sends nothing now. If it is ever added, it will only run if you allow it here. Google would then receive data about app usage and your device (e.g. an installation ID and IP address), which is not anonymous. Your Moj Elektro data never.

A free tool of the Energy Agency with which households and small businesses compare the offers of electricity and natural gas suppliers. The tool has existed since the market opened in 2007; the renewed version also covers offers with dynamic electricity prices.

You enter your annual electricity (or gas) consumption in kWh and choose your municipality. The other fields are optional and refine the calculation to your consumption. For dynamic prices, several hourly load profiles are available that better reflect consumption by hour.

The comparison includes all price lists that suppliers have entered into the application and that the Energy Agency has confirmed. The suppliers are responsible for the data being current and correct; the Agency performs a basic check. The list of suppliers is in the calculator itself (»Prikaz tržnih udeležencev«).

The calculator runs on the Energy Agency\'s website, not in Tarifni semafor – moja poraba. The app does not see, collect or store what you enter. By entering your annual consumption you agree that the Agency processes it to compare offers. Read the terms of use first; if you do not agree with them, do not enter any data.

Total consumption: %1$s kWh. The estimate covers only the network charge (power and energy) with 22 %% VAT, without excise duties, levies and other charges. It is for information only and does not replace your bill.

The network charge is billed by time blocks. Block 1 is the most expensive, block 5 the cheapest. You save the most by moving large appliances to cheaper blocks and by not switching on several powerful appliances at once.
The tips are general and for information only.
Move powerful appliances to cheaper blocks
If you can, run the washing machine, dishwasher, dryer and electric car charging at night or in cheaper blocks. The current block and the next cheapest block are on the home screen.
Do not switch everything on at once
The power rate is charged on the billing power of each block. Power peaks in a block affect the billing power the operator sets for you for the next year.
If you exceed your agreed billing power, the excess power is also taken into account in the network charge.
Most washing machines and dishwashers have a timer. Set it so that the programme starts in a cheaper block.
If you can, set a charging schedule or a power limit so that you do not create a high peak in the more expensive blocks.
The values for each block are on your network charge bill.
The higher season is more expensive
In the higher season (November–February) block 1 also applies, but only on working days. That is when adapting your consumption matters most.
